<span id="amascut-the-devourer" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
= <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><nowiki>Amascut, the Devourer</nowiki></span> =
<div class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed pvme-export-media-meta" style="margin:0.8em 0;padding:0.6em 0.8em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;max-width:100%;"><strong>Contents</strong><div class="mw-collapsible-content" style="max-height:24em;overflow:auto;">
{{ToC|align=none|clear=none|width=100%|limit=2}}
</div></div>


<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/EFlnaJbrvr.png</span></p>
<div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="introduction" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>The aim of this guide is to provide a basic overview of how to get consistent kills at Amascut, the Devourer. Due to the boss' high defence levels, demanding DPS checks and mechanical complexity, contents of this guide assume you have at least made it to the end of Stage 1 of </nowiki><span><nowiki>#upgrade-order</nowiki></span><nowiki> for your chosen style. As Amascut is enrage-based with fixed enrages of 100, 500, 750, 1000, 2000 and 4000%, mechanics and strategies may differ based on enrage. For the purposes of this guide, 100% enrage will be utilized.</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="disclaimer" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Disclaimer</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>This guide, and its contents thereof, assume you are getting started with Amascut, and does not necessarily cover meta strategies.</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="general-information" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>General Information</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut, the Devourer is located in Menaphos. Fighting her requires completion of the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Eclipse of the Heart</nowiki></strong><nowiki> quest.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ She has variable LP based on chosen mode and enrage:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Normal Mode</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>: 4.0M</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>100%</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>: 5.5M</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>500%</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>: 7M</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>750%</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>: 8M</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>1000%</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>: 9M</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>2000%</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>: 12M</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>4000%</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>: 16M</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Defensively, Amascut has a Defence </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="defence">[[File:Defence.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>defence</nowiki>|<nowiki>defence</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> level of 95, with 2765 Armour and an affinity of 55 Affinity against all styles.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut is immune to stuns </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="stunicon">https://files.catbox.moe/a5tul8.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> and poison </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="poisonicon">https://files.catbox.moe/x89b01.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Her minions can be poisoned and stunned.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut is mechanically complex, consisting of 5 phases in Normal and 7 phases in Enrage mode.</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:5px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.08);">
<span id="gear-relics-familiars" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Gear, Relics, Familiars</nowiki></ins></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>The following presets are based on Stage 1 and provided by Amascut, the Devourer Discord:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=c9915f48-ad2f-4a74-bc28-de538d40826e <nowiki>Necromancy</nowiki>]<span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;" title="Amascut Basic - Necromancy">https://files.catbox.moe/6znx63.webp<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;font-size:0.85em;">[https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/cba8d6dd68abecd4861b4e0eed8cbb75ccdc217835961584c9d68464ed4c4352.webp Image source]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=nfm2UnsVqmKfaFDf2Z9X <nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]
<span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:502px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://files.catbox.moe/7w9q8v.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;font-size:0.85em;">[https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fnfm2UnsVqmKfaFDf2Z9X.png?alt=media Image source]</span></span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="fight-mechanics-phases-1-3" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (Phases 1 &amp; 3)</nowiki></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut attacks with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, with a mechanic every 3 auto attacks</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Magic attacks deal damage to all players, and is telegraphed by Amascut raising her left hand and shooting out a green ball of energy</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee attacks deal damage to whoever has Amascut's aggression, and any player within 2-3 tiles near them; telegraphed by Amascut raising her right hand and slashing her target</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Melee attacks will additionally cause </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> arrows to fly at anyone within 10 tiles of her target once the melee hit lands</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Every 4 auto attacks, Amascut will perform </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Rapid Swipes</nowiki></ins><nowiki> where she starts viciously swiping at her target, dealing 2 quick hits of </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> damage based on her last used style, followed by a double hit that inflicts both types of damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In higher enrages, this has massive KO potential</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="attack-rotation" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Attack Rotation</nowiki></ins></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ This rotation assumes Amascut is not phased by reaching her hitcap</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>⬥ 3 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> auto attacks → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Tri-colour Attack</nowiki></em><nowiki> → Rapid swipes + 2 auto attacks → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Summon Scarabs</nowiki></em><nowiki> → 1 auto attack + Rapid swipes + 1 auto attack → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Soul Crush</nowiki></em><nowiki> → 2 auto attacks + Rapid swipes → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Triple Strike</nowiki></em><nowiki> → 3 auto attacks → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Tri-colour Attack</nowiki></em><nowiki> → Rapid swipes + 2 auto attacks → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Hard phase</nowiki></em><nowiki> (Amascut enters P2 or P4 depending on which phase the players were on)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If the players reach phase hitcap for P1 and/or P3, Amascut will reset her mechanics rotation (starting over with Tri-colour attack being her first mechanic), but will </nowiki><ins><nowiki>not</nowiki></ins><nowiki> reset her auto attack rotation (if she entered P2 after landing Rapid swipes, her P3 rotation will start with 3 regular auto attacks)</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="corruption" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Corruption</nowiki></ins> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="corruption">[[File:Corruption (status).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>corruption</nowiki>|<nowiki>corruption</nowiki>]]</span></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Persistent mechanic that increases all incoming damage by 10% per stack</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Capped at 15 stacks for a total of 150% damage increase</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Sources:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut's auto-attacks against her </nowiki><ins><nowiki>main target</nowiki></ins><nowiki> each inflict a stack</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Getting hit by Devourer's Shockwaves or Soulfire Waves inflict a stack</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="tri-colour-attack" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Tri-colour Attack</nowiki></ins></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut will flash 3 orbs in order, </nowiki><ins><nowiki>one for each style</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, and attack the Base Tank in the order she flashed the orbs</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The attacks deal heavy damage if not prayed against, and will stun the player taking them at 500% enrage or higher</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut </nowiki><ins><nowiki>telegraphs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> which styles she will attack with when she performs the mechanic:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;line-height:1.9;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Pathetic</nowiki></code><nowiki>: </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;line-height:1.9;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Weak</nowiki></code><nowiki>: </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;line-height:1.9;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Grovel</nowiki></code><nowiki>: </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="anti">[[File:Anticipation.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>anti</nowiki>|<nowiki>anti</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> protects against being stunned at 500% enrage or higher</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Only affects the Base Tank, other roles are safe</nowiki></p>
<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;margin:0.9em 0;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;">[https://img.pvme.io/images/ZO7c5iux5L.mp4 <nowiki>Watch clip</nowiki>]</span>

</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="summon-scarabs" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Summon Scarabs</nowiki></ins></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut summons 2-5 scarabs per player based on enrage, charging up over time</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The scarabs are Immune to damage until they are stunned</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Once fully charged, they explode, dealing soft typeless damage to all players in the arena</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Their damage can be mitigated entirely by casting </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If unavailable, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="powerburstofvitality">[[File:Powerburst of vitality (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>|<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can be used as a last resort</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Stepping on them as they spawn will prevent them from spawning entirely, doing so will reset the cooldown of </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dive">[[File:Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dive</nowiki>|<nowiki>dive</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Stunning them will lift their damage immunity and kill them due to their low health (2000 LP)</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="soul-crush-aka-bend-the-knee" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Soul Crush</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (a.k.a. Bend the Knee)</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut deals massive soft typeless damage to her main target, split between all players in a 3x3 radius of her target</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Has 50% piercing against defensive abilities</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Base Tank can </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="immort">[[File:Immortality.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>immort</nowiki>|<nowiki>immort</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> at the end of </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Tri-colour Attack</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> at earliest to negate this mechanic, assuming they do not proc it earlier</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ DPS pile can </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> Soul Crush and split it between themselves, using </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> + </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="powerburstofvitality">[[File:Powerburst of vitality (4).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>|<nowiki>powerburstofvitality</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to stay alive</nowiki></p>
<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;margin:0.9em 0;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;">[https://img.pvme.io/images/DTnk2wbbf4.mp4 <nowiki>Watch clip</nowiki>]</span>

</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="triple-strike" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Triple Strike</nowiki></ins></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut alters the skybox colour and prepares to launch 3 devastating hits with the same style she calls out</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Not praying against the hits correctly deals massive damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Affects all players in the encounter</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut </nowiki><ins><nowiki>telegraphs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> which style she will attack with when she performs the mechanic:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;line-height:1.9;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>All strength withers</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎(skybox turns </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>red</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>): 3 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> hits</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;line-height:1.9;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>I will not suffer this</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎(skybox turns </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>green</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>): 3 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> hits</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;line-height:1.9;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Your soul is WEAK</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎(skybox turns </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>blue</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>): 3 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> hits</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> will fully protect you from all 3 hits, as long as you are praying against the style correctly</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If timed correctly, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="divert">[[File:Divert.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>divert</nowiki>|<nowiki>divert</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can gain a massive amount of healing and adren respectively from the third hit</nowiki></p>
<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;margin:0.9em 0;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;">[https://img.pvme.io/images/SH08p0rCVi.mp4 <nowiki>Watch clip</nowiki>]</span>

</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="fight-mechanics-phases-2-4" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (Phases 2 &amp; 4)</nowiki></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut stops attacking, becomes Immune to all damage, and charges a wipe mechanic</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ She will invoke the names of two of the Bau of Tumeken (Apmeken and Crondis in Phase 2, Scabaras and Het in Phase 4), causing their respective mechanics to become active</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Failure to complete this phase in less than 200 seconds will result in a </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>WIPE</nowiki></strong></ins> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="instakill">https://files.catbox.moe/bbrsx2.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This timer is reduced to 125 seconds at 1000% enrage, and further reduced to 100 seconds at 2000%</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="statues-fragments" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Statues &amp; Fragments</nowiki></ins></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The statues of the Bau of Tumeken are </nowiki><ins><nowiki>corrupted</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, and must be </nowiki><ins><nowiki>cleansed</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and </nowiki><ins><nowiki>restored</nowiki></ins><nowiki> to progress the fight</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Clicking on the statue while they are glowing </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>green</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> will deal hard typeless damage to all players in the encounter</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The statues can be </nowiki><ins><nowiki>cleansed</nowiki></ins><nowiki> by clicking on them once they start glowing </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>golden</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> (indicating a </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Chain</nowiki></ins><nowiki> inside was brought to 0 HP), doing so three times will cleanse the statue, allowing it to be restored</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The statues can be </nowiki><ins><nowiki>restored</nowiki></ins><nowiki> by bringing its respective Fragment of Tumeken to them, this will stagger Amascut, interrupting her channelling and removing her damage immunity, allowing the encounter to be progressed</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once both statues for that phase are </nowiki><ins><nowiki>restored</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, the phase ends when Amascut is damaged to her hitcap, or once she fully recovers</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="portals-inside-rooms" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Portals</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (Inside Rooms)</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ In order to cleanse the statues, players must enter through a portal on each side of the arena, guarded by a </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Gatekeeper gorilla akh</nowiki></ins></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Gatekeeper gorilla akh</nowiki></ins><nowiki> has crawling speed, can potentially stun players with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> attacks</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once inside, the players must work together and towards killing the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Chainwarden mage akh</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>chains</nowiki></ins><nowiki> preventing the players from claiming a </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Fragment of Tumeken</nowiki></ins></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The chains, once they drop to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>0 LP</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, must be </nowiki><ins><nowiki>cleansed</nowiki></ins><nowiki> to fully destroy them, and once all three are destroyed, the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Fragment of Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki> can be claimed to restore its respective statue</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Gatekeeper gorilla akh</nowiki></ins><nowiki> can be dispatched relatively easily with high burst damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Inside (Chains) and Outside (Statues) players must work together to take out the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Chainwarden</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, Chains player takes out </nowiki><strong><nowiki>two</nowiki></strong><nowiki> chains and carries the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Fragment of Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, while the Statues player takes out </nowiki><strong><nowiki>one</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and cleanses their side's statue</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In Phase 4, both players remain inside as the Base Tank can singlehandedly cleanse both statues due to their proximity</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Chains player runs the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Fragment of Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki> across the arena, the correct statue to </nowiki><ins><nowiki>restore</nowiki></ins><nowiki> is on the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>opposite</nowiki></strong><nowiki> side of where they entered through the portal (e.g. East player must ferry the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>fragments</nowiki></ins><nowiki> to the Western statues)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• While carrying the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Fragment of Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="surge">[[File:Surge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>surge</nowiki>|<nowiki>surge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="escape">[[File:Escape.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>escape</nowiki>|<nowiki>escape</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> &amp; </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dive">[[File:Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dive</nowiki>|<nowiki>dive</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> are disabled, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="barge">[[File:Barge.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>barge</nowiki>|<nowiki>barge</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can still be utilised</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note:</nowiki></em> <em><nowiki>Gatekeeper gorilla akhs have a chance to stun you with their melee attacks starting at 1000% enrage</nowiki></em></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="apmekens-burden" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Apmeken's Burden</nowiki></ins> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="apmekensburden">[[File:Apmeken's Burden.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402579857648390224.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>apmekensburden</nowiki>|<nowiki>apmekensburden</nowiki>]]</span></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Shortly after Phase 2 starts, Amascut marks one random player who is outside with </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Apmeken's Burden</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, a hard hitting bleed that deals typeless damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The bleed wears off after a while, length based on enrage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Apmeken's Burden</nowiki></ins><nowiki> deals damage to a player for the 8th time (indicated by the number of stacks on the debuff), that player is </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>instakilled</nowiki></strong></ins> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="instakill">https://files.catbox.moe/bbrsx2.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Players can pass </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Apmeken's Burden</nowiki></ins><nowiki> around to reset its stacks, to pass the debuff the player must be standing in a 1 tile radius of the player who </nowiki><strong><nowiki>never</nowiki></strong><nowiki> got the burden during the phase when its damage ticks</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Should the debuff be applied, it can be safely ignored in enrages less than 2000% as it will never instakill </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="instakill">https://files.catbox.moe/bbrsx2.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Apmeken's Burden</nowiki></ins><nowiki> can be skipped </nowiki><strong><nowiki>entirely</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, if Amascut cannot find a target when she tries to mark a player (e.g. all players are inside the portal) the debuff will never be applied</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="modest-crocodile-demons" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Modest Crocodile Demons</nowiki></ins> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="modesty">[[File:Modesty.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402583151322071091.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>modesty</nowiki>|<nowiki>modesty</nowiki>]]</span></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ At the start of Phase 2, and again once a player starts running the Fragment of Tumeken from Crondis, two </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Modest crocodile demons</nowiki></ins><nowiki> will spawn, one for each side of the arena</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Modest crocodile demons primarily attack with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="range">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>range</nowiki>|<nowiki>range</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, sometimes attacking with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> if their target is too close</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once the adrenaline bar above their head is charged, they fire a </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> attack that </nowiki><strong><nowiki>cannot miss</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, draining the player's adrenaline by 20% and halving their adrenaline gain for a short time</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ These creatures have the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Modesty</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Provoke Immune</nowiki></ins><nowiki> buffs, reflecting damage from enhanced and ultimate abilities, as well as special attacks while preventing </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> from changing their targets</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Pray against their attacks and use basic abilities and conjures </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="conjurearmy">[[File:Conjure Undead Army.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>conjurearmy</nowiki>|<nowiki>conjurearmy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to kill them</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Necromancers are strongly recommended to </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="invokedeath">[[File:Invoke Death icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>invokedeath</nowiki>|<nowiki>invokedeath</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> as it will speed up the kills</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ They will attack the first target they see until they lose them; as they are </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Provoke Immune</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, Statues roles should have their aggro once the second set spawns, Base Tank can tank/dispatch the first set</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="healing-in-strength" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Healing in Strength</nowiki></ins> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="healinginstrength">[[File:Healing in Strength.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585055297273896.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>healinginstrength</nowiki>|<nowiki>healinginstrength</nowiki>]]</span></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut will heal for a portion of all damage dealt by her minions (except for the Chainwarden mage akh) during Phase 4</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ This mechanic can be safely ignored as the healing is usually negligible</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If going for </nowiki><strong><nowiki>You Shall Not Heal</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Combat Achievement, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ent">[[File:Entangle icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ent</nowiki>|<nowiki>ent</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="icebarrage">[[File:Ice Barrage icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>icebarrage</nowiki>|<nowiki>icebarrage</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="stickybomb">[[File:Sticky bomb.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074306301964.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>stickybomb</nowiki>|<nowiki>stickybomb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is strongly recommended to stop </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Feline guard akhs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Gorilla gatekeeper akhs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> from dealing damage with their attacks</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="explosive-scarab-akhs" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Explosive Scarab Akhs</nowiki></ins> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="carapace">[[File:Carapace (status).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585081624924210.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>carapace</nowiki>|<nowiki>carapace</nowiki>]]</span></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ During Phase 4, Amascut will summon </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Explosive scarab akhs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> with </nowiki><strong><nowiki>5000 LP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and no damage immunity</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In addition to the scarabs, Gorilla gatekeeper akhs, Chainwarden mage akhs and Chains all gain damage immunity through the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Carapace</nowiki></ins> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="carapace">[[File:Carapace (status).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585081624924210.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>carapace</nowiki>|<nowiki>carapace</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> buff</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ On death, the scarabs will start filling a bar above their head, causing them to explode once filled dealing soft typeless damage to all players in the arena</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Any remaining scarabs at the end of Phase 4 will simultaneously die and start charging</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Scarabs can be </nowiki><ins><nowiki>grabbed</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and tossed at targets once they have been killed and start charging their explosion, doing so will lift the Carapace buff from enemies (green glow around them)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To throw a scarab, click on a dead scarab to grab, then click on a target to throw it</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ At the start of Phase 5, use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cade">[[File:Barricade.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cade</nowiki>|<nowiki>cade</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to null all of their damage as they explode</nowiki></p>
<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;margin:0.9em 0;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;">[https://img.pvme.io/images/TH3J0tKcHR.mp4 <nowiki>Watch clip</nowiki>]</span>

</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="floor-mechanics-devourers-shockwaves-soulfire-waves-devourers-hieroglyphs" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Floor Mechanics</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (Devourer's Shockwaves, Soulfire Waves, Devourer's Hieroglyphs)</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut will blast the ground with high damage </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Shockwaves</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Hieroglyphs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> or </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Soulfire Waves</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, similar to Nakatra in Sanctum of Rebirth</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Shockwaves</nowiki></ins><nowiki> have a fixed pattern and deal typeless damage, disabling defensive abilities and putting them on cooldown for 6s</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Soulfire Waves</nowiki></ins><nowiki> sweep the arena in a set pattern dealing high </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> damage and lowering the duration of </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Hieroglyphs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> split the arena into 9 5x5 tiles, dealing heavy typeless damage and disabling defensive abilities as well as putting them on cooldown for 6s</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Shockwaves appear in Phases 2 (West side), Phase 3, Phase 4 (East side) and Phase 7</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Soulfire Waves appear in Phase 2 and Phase 4</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Hieroglyphs appear in Phase 7 only</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ All floor mechanics are telegraphed, move out of the way if possible</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For Soulfire Waves, praying </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> will mitigate some damage, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="divert">[[File:Divert.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>divert</nowiki>|<nowiki>divert</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="disrupt">[[File:Disruption Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>|<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> both block one hit, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can block hits while praying but will suffer duration reduction</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ In Phase 7, dodging </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Shockwaves</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Hieroglyphs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> will </nowiki><ins><nowiki>reset the cooldowns</nowiki></ins><nowiki> of all movement abilities</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="fight-mechanics-phase-5" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (Phase 5)</nowiki></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut will go Immune once again, and summons a pair of soul obelisks that slowly charge towards periodic bursts of </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ To progress the fight, the players must work together to charge the Fragments of Tumeken freed in Phases 2 and 4</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ There is no timer in this phase</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="altar-charging" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Altar Charging</nowiki></ins></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Four fragments of Tumeken, two on each side of the arena, will appear directly across the statues</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Far</nowiki></ins><nowiki> fragments are Crondis and Apmeken, and can be charged by the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Solo Charge</nowiki></ins><nowiki> role</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Near</nowiki></ins><nowiki> fragments are Scabaras and Het, and must be charged by the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>South Charge</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Interceptors</nowiki></ins></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ To charge a fragment, the players must form a bridge to carry Tumeken's light shooting out of the statues</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Once at least 1 fragment is charged, players can click on </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki> to start reforming him</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ideally, at least 2 fragments must be charged before clicking on Tumeken to start reformation</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="soul-obelisks" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Soul Obelisks</nowiki></ins></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ A </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Soul obelisk</nowiki></ins><nowiki> will spawn on each side of the arena, slowly charging up its health</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Once fully charged, it will start dealing periodic </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to all players in a fairly large AoE</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ So long as the obelisks take damage, they will not charge up</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Using a damage over time ability </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="bloat">[[File:Bloat.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>bloat</nowiki>|<nowiki>bloat</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="combust">[[File:Combust.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>combust</nowiki>|<nowiki>combust</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> will stop it from charging up without having to actively focus it</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Finishing a charging cycle will also reset the obelisks</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="lightstealer-salawa-akhs-aka-dogs" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Lightstealer salawa akhs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (a.k.a. Dogs)</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ While any number of altars are charging, </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Lightstealer salawa akhs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (dogs) will emerge from the southern stairs, moving towards the charging fragments</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If the dogs make it to their target, they will start to slowly charge up, then sacrifice themselves after fully charging, setting back progression for that fragment by a significant amount</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the fragments have been recalled, they will target Tumeken instead; if they deplete Tumeken's health, it will result in a </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>WIPE</nowiki></strong></ins> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="instakill">https://files.catbox.moe/bbrsx2.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Players at the southern side of the arena can use </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ent">[[File:Entangle icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ent</nowiki>|<nowiki>ent</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="icebarrage">[[File:Ice Barrage icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>icebarrage</nowiki>|<nowiki>icebarrage</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="stickybomb">[[File:Sticky bomb.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074306301964.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>stickybomb</nowiki>|<nowiki>stickybomb</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to stop the dogs from moving</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Attacking will also change their target to the player who dealt damage to them</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>⬥ As soon as Tumeken recalls all fragments and starts reforming, they become high priority targets; strong AoE rotations (e.g. </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="gchain">[[File:Greater Chain.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>gchain</nowiki>|<nowiki>gchain</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="omnipowerigneous">https://files.catbox.moe/gsklcq.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> ) must be utilized to remove them from the arena as quickly as possible</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note:</nowiki></em> <em><nowiki>Lightstealer salawa akhs will remember their progress to snuff out the light of one of Tumeken's fragments, e.g. if one of them had their charge bar halfway full and switch target over to Tumeken himself, they will continue charging from where they left off, this can lead to unexpected wipes</nowiki></em></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="altar-strike" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Altar Strike</nowiki></ins></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ So long as any altars are charging, Amascut will say </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Your light will be snuffed out once and for all</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and launch 1-4 arrows at the altars based on how many altars are charging, dealing heavy damage and reducing a fragment's charge by a significant amount</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Two Interceptor players (Green 1 &amp; Green 2) take turns to stand in front of Amascut, stopping the bolts from flying at the altars; refer to the image below for positioning</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Interrupting Altar Strike deals soft typeless damage that also inflicts the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Interceptor</nowiki></ins><nowiki> debuff, any player with the debuff that gets hit again with Altar Strike is instakilled </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="instakill">https://files.catbox.moe/bbrsx2.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The debuff is cleared if another player intercepts the bolts</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Incoming damage should be mitigated with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="debil">[[File:Debilitate.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>debil</nowiki>|<nowiki>debil</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ One good tip is to drop down a </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="prismofsalvation">[[File:Prism of Salvation icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109431029761.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>prismofsalvation</nowiki>|<nowiki>prismofsalvation</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> at the North Charge spot for the Interceptors to swap more easily</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;max-width:100%;width:700px;margin:0.9em 0;">https://img.pvme.io/images/lfr0z98VqG.png</span></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="the-god-of-destruction-aka-blinking-strikes" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>The God of Destruction</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (a.k.a. Blinking strikes)</nowiki></span> ===
