<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ As soon as Tumeken starts reforming, Amascut becomes damageable and blinks to a random side of the arena (North, South, West or East), dealing </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> damage and stunning any player in her way</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ During this stage, Amascut will charge four devastating attacks (once per jump) that will deplete Tumeken's reformation progress</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If not intercepted properly or intercepted at all, it will set back Tumeken's reformation progress and deal heavy soft typeless damage to all players as well as stunning them</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Tumeken's life bar depletes, the players </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>WIPE</nowiki></strong></ins> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="instakill">https://files.catbox.moe/bbrsx2.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki> will call a player to intercept the attack by saying </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>&lt;playername&gt;, shield us from her shadow...</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The player who is called out will notice their skybox turn </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>golden</nowiki></strong></ins></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The player called out by Tumeken </nowiki><strong><nowiki>must be the first player</nowiki></strong><nowiki> to be hit by Amascut's attack, intercepting it and preventing potentially lethal damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If they are not the first player to get hit, the attack will deal damage as if it wasn't intercepted at all</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ All players who are standing in a line between Amascut and Tumeken will take typeless damage and have the cooldowns of all mobility abilities reset, allowing easy repositioning</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: Tumeken will </nowiki><ins><nowiki>never</nowiki></ins><nowiki> call the same player to intercept twice in a row</nowiki></em></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="fight-mechanics-phase-6" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (Phase 6)</nowiki></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut will summon an </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Engulfing shadow</nowiki></ins><nowiki> that consumes Tumeken, constantly bombarding the arena with projectiles that deal heavy typeless damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ To progress the fight, the players must follow </nowiki><ins><nowiki>the Path of Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and take </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Tumeken's light</nowiki></ins></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="the-path-of-tumeken-aka-platforms" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>The Path of Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (a.k.a. Platforms)</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The center hieroglyph either on west or east side of the arena will </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>start glowing</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>, indicating that a player can follow </nowiki><ins><nowiki>the Path of Tumeken</nowiki></ins></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ The player following </nowiki><ins><nowiki>the Path of Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (climbing) must kill </nowiki><strong><nowiki>four</nowiki></strong><nowiki> mage/range akhs in </nowiki><strong><nowiki>30 seconds</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the collapse timer runs out, the climber is instakilled </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="instakill">https://files.catbox.moe/bbrsx2.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki>, and Amascut will deal however much black health she has as typeless damage to players, split between all players in the arena</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Akhs have only </nowiki><strong><nowiki>15k</nowiki></strong><nowiki> LP, high burst damage will kill them in one or (at worst) two hits</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ While climbing, the climber will see a </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>glowing</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> hieroglyph under the platform they're standing on, if another player stands on the same glyph the climber calls out, the collapse timer will be paused until the next platform</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Once the four akhs are dead, the climber can click on </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Tumeken's light</nowiki></ins><nowiki> to finish climbing and gain the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Enlightened</nowiki></ins> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="interceptor">[[File:Interceptor.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>interceptor</nowiki>|<nowiki>interceptor</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> buff, for the remainder of the phase they are Amascut's main target</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="climber-rotations" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><nowiki>Climber Rotations</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Both rotations assume they start as soon as Amascut calls </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>I WILL NOT BE DENIED</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎at the start of Phase 6</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="chaosroar">[[File:Chaos light</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>Add a basic attack </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="necrobasic">https://files.catbox.moe/0f4gm8.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="meleebasic">https://files.catbox.moe/krhnzs.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> if they don't die in 1 GCD</nowiki></p>
<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;margin:0.9em 0;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;">[https://img.pvme.io/images/r6hPuPjueK.mp4 <nowiki>Watch clip</nowiki>]</span>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>At 2000% Enrage and higher, a climber will be chosen randomly by Tumeken, indicated by their skybox turning golden</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>As a last ditch effort, if the climber times out </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="instakill">https://files.catbox.moe/bbrsx2.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki>, a well timed </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="immort">[[File:Immortality.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>immort</nowiki>|<nowiki>immort</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> will negate all of the damage, but Amascut will have much higher health than if she was phased normally</nowiki></em></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="engulfing-shadow-shadow-tears" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Engulfing shadow &amp; Shadow tears</nowiki></ins></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ At the center of the arena is the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Engulfing shadow</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, which continuously increases Amascut's shield (black health) for the phase based on how much life it has</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Every time the climber kills a range/mage akh, </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Engulfing shadow tears</nowiki></ins><nowiki> will spawn across the arena, increasing in quantity for each akh killed and number of players present</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These tears will heal the Engulfing shadow for 1000 health every tick, and for 15K health if not absorbed in time</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Engulfing shadow </nowiki><ins><nowiki>cannot be killed</nowiki></ins><nowiki>; the players on ground level must deal as much damage to it as possible to keep its health low</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="invokedeath">[[File:Invoke Death icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>invokedeath</nowiki>|<nowiki>invokedeath</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> is counterintuitive as the shadow will respawn with more health</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Engulfing shadow tears can be absorbed, preventing them from healing the larger Engulfing shadow, doing so will inflict a stacking debuff </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="combust">[[File:Combust.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>combust</nowiki>|<nowiki>combust</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> that deals </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> will fully block the hit, but is best reserved for Clones</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="shadows-of-amascut-aka-clones" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Shadows of Amascut</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (a.k.a. Clones)</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Once </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Tumeken's light</nowiki></ins><nowiki> is claimed by the climber, Amascut will summon a </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Shadow of Amascut</nowiki></ins><nowiki> for each player alive who isn't the climber</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If outside melee distance, they will dash at their target dealing </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> damage, if in melee distance they will swipe at their target dealing </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If not all of them are dead at the same time, dead clones will deal huge damage to all players who aren't standing in the climber's </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Enlightened</nowiki></ins> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="interceptor">[[File:Interceptor.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>interceptor</nowiki>|<nowiki>interceptor</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> buff</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Go directly behind Amascut and stack up with the rest of the DPS pile who aren't climbing, pray </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for the initial dash attack from clones, pray </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="melee">[[File:Melee icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>melee</nowiki>|<nowiki>melee</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> afterwards</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Kill them as quickly as possible with a strong AoE rotation (assumes you start as soon as she says </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>I WILL NOT BE SUBJUGATED BY A MORTAL!</nowiki></code><nowiki>, adjust timing based on clone spawn):</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Necromancy </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="tsunamiincite">https://files.catbox.moe/xkpzfo.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dbreath">[[File:Dragon Breath.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dbreath</nowiki>|<nowiki>dbreath</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → improvise</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut becomes damageable once the clones are dead, unload as much damage as you can in ~20 seconds to remove her black HP and deal damage to her real HP to make Phase 7 easier</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Necromancy </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="necromancy">[[File:Necromancy.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>|<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>]]</span></strong><nowiki>: Aim to enter Phase 7 with at least 8 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="necrosis">[[File:Necrosis.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>necrosis</nowiki>|<nowiki>necrosis</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and 4 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="residualsoul">[[File:Residual Soul.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>residualsoul</nowiki>|<nowiki>residualsoul</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: The climber can deal damage to Amascut's shield directly with their </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Enlightened</nowiki></ins> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="interceptor">[[File:Interceptor.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>interceptor</nowiki>|<nowiki>interceptor</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> buff</nowiki></em></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="player-bomb" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Player Bomb</nowiki></ins></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If the clones are not killed in time, Amascut will turn the players under attack by her clones into bombs, dealing ~12k typeless damage with defensive penetration to all players in a 7x7 area after a short time</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Finish off all clones before the players detonate, nulling all damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If the clones cannot be finished off in time, players must stand near the climber who has the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Enlightened</nowiki></ins> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="interceptor">[[File:Interceptor.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>interceptor</nowiki>|<nowiki>interceptor</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> buff (appears as a golden aura around them) to null most of the damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Note: Any blast from outside the Enlightenment buff will still clip players who are inside of it</nowiki></em></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="fight-mechanics-phase-7" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (Phase 7)</nowiki></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut pulls all players towards her and teleports them to a twisted version of the Throne Room, gaining </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Inner Shadow</nowiki></ins> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="shadowlink">[[File:Shadow Link.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1403076345084379337.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>shadowlink</nowiki>|<nowiki>shadowlink</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> buff that massively reduces incoming damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ To finish the fight, players must withstand Amascut's onslaught and lower her health to 0 while preventing Tumeken from dying by intercepting her attacks on him</nowiki></p>
<div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="tumeken-strike" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Tumeken Strike</nowiki></ins></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ After 4 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> auto attacks in the first cycle and 3 </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> auto attacks in subsequent cycles, Amascut will address one of the Bau of Tumeken by name and face Tumeken directly, charging an extremely powerful attack</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If intercepted incorrectly or not intercepted at all, the attack deals massive damage to Tumeken and heavy soft typeless damage to all players in the Throne Room</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Tumeken dies, the team </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>WIPES</nowiki></strong></ins> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="instakill">https://files.catbox.moe/bbrsx2.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Players are assigned a quadrant based on their P2/4 roles, with Base Tank acting as fill should a player die</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Inside players are usually expected to go North, while Outside players go South</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut must be </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> towards the correct statue within ~3 GCDs, based on the following callouts:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="healinginstrength">[[File:Healing in Strength.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585055297273896.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>healinginstrength</nowiki>|<nowiki>healinginstrength</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>Het</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Forgive me, Het.</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎(Southwest)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="apmekensburden">[[File:Apmeken's Burden.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402579857648390224.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>apmekensburden</nowiki>|<nowiki>apmekensburden</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>Apmeken</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>I am sorry, Apmeken.</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎(Northwest)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="modesty">[[File:Modesty.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402583151322071091.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>modesty</nowiki>|<nowiki>modesty</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>Crondis</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Crondis... It should have never come to this.</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎(Southeast)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="carapace">[[File:Carapace (status).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585081624924210.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>carapace</nowiki>|<nowiki>carapace</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>Scabaras</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><code style="font-size:1em;padding:0.1em 0.25em;"><nowiki>Scabaras...</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎(Northeast)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Once </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to correct statue, move out of the way or </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="disrupt">[[File:Disruption Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>|<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to survive the massive followup typeless hit</nowiki></p>
<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="display:block;margin:0.9em 0;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-left:4px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:5px;">[https://img.pvme.io/images/JKyDStksJE.mp4 <nowiki>Watch clip</nowiki>]</span>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><em><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>A singular bolt of light will shoot out from Tumeken to the correct statue, acting as a visual indicator for which statue is the correct one</nowiki></em></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>Statues in the room can be examined if in doubt about which statue is the correct one to stand in front of</nowiki></em></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="tumeken-strike-cont-on-fail" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Tumeken Strike</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (cont., on Fail)</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If the players </nowiki><strong><nowiki>fail</nowiki></strong><nowiki> the Tumeken Strike mechanic, players will take massive typeless damage, and </nowiki><ins><nowiki>shadow tears</nowiki></ins><nowiki> will spawn across the room, while she resumes </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> auto attacks</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut's main target will also be targeted with </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Soul Crush</nowiki></ins><nowiki> after 3 auto attacks</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="disrupt">[[File:Disruption Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>|<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> pre-emptively to avoid taking huge typeless damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Tumeken dies, it doesn't matter as the team wipes instead</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Try to collect as many Shadow Tears as you can, as they will heal Amascut for 1000 LP/tick per orb</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1px solid #9eb1a7;border-radius:5px;line-height:2.1;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.07);"><nowiki>⬥ Huddle together or (Base Tank) </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> → </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="res">[[File:Resonance.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>res</nowiki>|<nowiki>res</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="disrupt">[[File:Disruption Shield icon.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>|<nowiki>disrupt</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="immort">[[File:Immortality.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>immort</nowiki>|<nowiki>immort</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> (depending on enrage) to survive </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Soul Crush</nowiki></ins></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.4em 0;padding:1em 1.2em;border:1px solid #8ca69b;border-top:3px solid #4d7b6b;border-radius:6px;background-color:rgba(110,145,127,0.06);">
<span id="tumeken-strike-cont-on-success" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
=== <span style="line-height:1.4;"><ins style="text-decoration:none;"><nowiki>Tumeken Strike</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (cont., on Success)</nowiki></span> ===

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If the players successfully handle the Tumeken Strike mechanic, Tumeken will take light damage and players will gain </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Light Within</nowiki></ins> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="interceptor">[[File:Interceptor.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>interceptor</nowiki>|<nowiki>interceptor</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for 30s, lifting the damage cap from Inner Shadow </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="shadowlink">[[File:Shadow Link.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1403076345084379337.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>shadowlink</nowiki>|<nowiki>shadowlink</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ During this phase, Amascut will continuously perform her </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Empowered Eruption</nowiki></ins><nowiki> attack, as well as </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Devourer's Hieroglyphs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Devourer's Shockwaves</nowiki></ins></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Based on which of the Bau of Tumeken was called, Amascut will invoke a mechanic from the previous phases:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Apmeken</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: A random player receives Apmeken's Burden </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="apmekensburden">[[File:Apmeken's Burden.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402579857648390224.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>apmekensburden</nowiki>|<nowiki>apmekensburden</nowiki>]]</span></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Crondis</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Two Modest crocodile demons </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="modesty">[[File:Modesty.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402583151322071091.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>modesty</nowiki>|<nowiki>modesty</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> spawn</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Het</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Amascut heals </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="healinginstrength">[[File:Healing in Strength.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585055297273896.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>healinginstrength</nowiki>|<nowiki>healinginstrength</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> for 25% of all damage she does to players</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Scabaras</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Amascut becomes shielded </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="carapace">[[File:Carapace (status).png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585081624924210.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>carapace</nowiki>|<nowiki>carapace</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and summons Explosive scarab akhs</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Try to deal as much burst damage as possible within the first few seconds of receiving the buff to finish off Amascut to skip all follow-up mechanics (except if Scabaras was called)</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Depending on which of the Bau of Tumeken was called:</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Apmeken</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Burden acts the same way as it does in Phase 2 and can be passed around between players, on lower enrages or if the boss can be bursted to 0 this can be ignored</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Het</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Can be safely ignored as the healing per hit from each attack is usually negligible</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Crondis</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Can be ignored if Amascut can be bursted down to 0 quickly, otherwise prioritise them to avoid taking too much off-style damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="deathskulls">[[File:Death Skulls.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>deathskulls</nowiki>|<nowiki>deathskulls</nowiki>]]</span> <strong><nowiki>will</nowiki></strong><nowiki> bounce onto the crocodiles, resulting in potentially fatal reflection damage</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Scabaras</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Players must throw 3 Explosive scarab akhs at Amascut to remove her shield</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Empowered Eruption and floor mechanics will happen in tandem, players must focus on dodging the floor mechanics and praying correctly with defensives if bursting Amascut down to 0 within the first few seconds of receiving the buff isn't possible</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div></div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
<span id="base-tank-troubleshooting" style="display:block;height:0;overflow:hidden;line-height:0;"></span>
== <span style="padding:0.15em 0 0.35em;line-height:1.35;"><nowiki>Base Tank Troubleshooting</nowiki></span> ==

<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>This section is reserved exclusively for troubleshooting Base Tank issues in higher enrages (1000%+), but may also be applicable for lower enrages.</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Modest crocodile demons attack at the same time with different styles</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Prioritize praying </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="magic">[[File:Magic.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>magic</nowiki>|<nowiki>magic</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> if getting off-styled on the same tick, as the </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="ranged">[[File:Ranged.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>ranged</nowiki>|<nowiki>ranged</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> attack </nowiki><em><nowiki>can</nowiki></em><nowiki> miss; </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="reflect">[[File:Reflect.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>|<nowiki>reflect</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> / </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="devo">[[File:Devotion.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>devo</nowiki>|<nowiki>devo</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> can negate a lot of damage from the crocodiles</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ Base Tank from </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="necromancy">[[File:Necromancy.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>|<nowiki>necromancy</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> spot becomes immobilised after tanking Soul Crush with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="immort">[[File:Immortality.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>immort</nowiki>|<nowiki>immort</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki>, leading to a follow up Devourer's Shockwaves hit</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dive">[[File:Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dive</nowiki>|<nowiki>dive</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> 1 tile outside the first (outer) set of shockwaves to avoid defensives reset, </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="cease">[[File:Cease.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864235458464186418.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>cease</nowiki>|<nowiki>cease</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> to avoid being moved back in</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="dive">[[File:Dive.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>dive</nowiki>|<nowiki>dive</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> 2+ tiles away from shockwaves can potentially make Amascut switch targets during Soul Crush</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Necessary if going for </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Dedicated Denial of Standing (here)</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Combat Achievement</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;"><nowiki>⬥ If Amascut starts P3 with Rapid Swipes, third one lines up right after Soul Crush, resulting in a high KO potential situation</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong> <span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="cadeturtling">https://files.catbox.moe/lat0z7.png<span class="pvme-export-media-meta" style="position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;font-size:0;line-height:1;">[https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1 <span style="display:block;width:100%;height:100%;">Image source</span>]</span></span><nowiki> with </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;position:relative;" title="turtling3">[[File:Turtling.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/974504834394898522.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>turtling3</nowiki>|<nowiki>turtling3</nowiki>]]<span class="pvme-export-media-meta pvme-export-rank" style="position:absolute;bottom:0;right:0;min-width:0.8em;padding:0 0.1em;border:1px solid #111;border-radius:2px;background-color:#fff;color:#111;font-size:0.65em;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;">3</span></span><nowiki> or better will cover Rapid Swipes and scarabs exploding</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;margin-left:1em;padding-left:0.8em;border-left:2px solid #a5b8af;"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Alternatively, the team can </nowiki><span style="display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);justify-items:stretch;vertical-align:middle;line-height:1;width:24px;max-width:24px;" title="voke">[[File:Provoke.png|24x24px|link=https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1|alt=<nowiki>voke</nowiki>|<nowiki>voke</nowiki>]]</span><nowiki> and split the big hit instead</nowiki></p>
<p style="max-width:86ch;margin:0.7em 0;line-height:1.7;height:0;overflow:hidden;margin:0;line-height:0;"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
</div><div style="margin:1.6em 0 2.2em;">
